I’m not able to place an actual Uber order for you, but I can walk you through what you’ll need to do so you’re ready when the time comes:

| Step | What to Do | Why |
|------|------------|-----|
| **1** | Open the Uber app (or visit uber.com via mobile browser). | You’ll need the app to schedule a ride. |
| **2** | Set “Pick‑up” to *Berkeley* – enter ZIP 94704 or let GPS locate you automatically. | Ensures the driver knows where to meet you. |
| **3** | Choose the vehicle type (“UberX”, “Comfort”, “XL”, etc.). | Pick the one that best fits your needs & budget. |
| **4** | Tap “Schedule a Ride”. | Allows you to set a future pickup time. |
| **5** | Enter the desired pick‑up time: 10 minutes from now. | Makes sure the driver arrives exactly then. |
| **6** | Confirm the destination address (optional). | If you already know where you’re heading, this speeds up booking. |
| **7** | Review fare estimate & confirm. | Gives you a clear idea of cost before confirming. |

### Quick Tips  
- **Check Availability:** In busy areas, some vehicles may take longer to arrive—schedule a bit earlier if possible.  
- **Payment Method:** Make sure your payment method is active in the app; otherwise the trip won’t complete.  
- **Driver ETA:** After scheduling, you’ll see the estimated arrival time of the assigned driver.  

Once those steps are done, you’ll receive a notification when the driver’s en route and another once they’ve arrived. Enjoy your ride!
